request: Mel's Rebuttal barrier disappears on the next simulation tick even though its duration is still active. With no incoming damage, it should remain during its active duration, then disappear when the duration expires. Investigate expiration handling and preserve consistent combat behavior.
analysis: Source inspection found barrier cleanup conditions using barrierUntil >= current time in both DexArena.Step and Combat.Tick, whereas damage absorption treats the barrier as active while barrierUntil > time. This suggests an expiration comparison issue, but no execution failure has yet been observed. The scenario exercises actual Rebuttal without incoming damage, checks persistence and expiration, and uses Morgana's Black Shield as a duration control.

reviewReason: The report explicitly requires persistence without damage until expiration. Original CastMel grants a barrier for two seconds, independently of the 0.75-second nova. The trace reproduces premature clearing on the first tick. Relative barrier assertions preserve existing balance rather than inventing it. Black Shield is a supported expiration control, but this witness focuses on the reported barrier lifecycle and unchanged health; it does not certify all combat behavior.

scenario.title: Rebuttal barrier persists until expiration without damage
scenario.expectedBehavior: Mel's Rebuttal grants a barrier that remains unchanged through simulation ticks before its two-second expiration and becomes zero afterward. Health remains unchanged without incoming damage. Morgana's independently cast Black Shield persists until its five-second expiration.
